notes.title: The Future of Ball Game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, its been too long hasn't it?


Ball Game REMIX has been in development for quite some time and a lot of that time has been spent with me doing college homework instead. I have lost focus in my places of what Ball Game is about, I wanted to add skins, new online mechanics, leaderboards, etc. when I should've just focused on the main game itself. Now that my first year of college is coming to a close and I'm (hopefully) passing with flying colors I have gotten back to work on the big kahuna itself, Ball Game REMIX. 

I want to announce that we will be redoing a LOT of what you have seen and plan to make the game a lot more interesting. We are NOT going to include online multiplayer but instead allow multiplayer through services like Parsec and Steam Remote Play. This decision was made due to me not having the money, time, and knowledge of making something like rollback netcode in Ball Game. We will still have the same cast of characters that you know and love just changed to look a little new so expect some good news soon.

Throughout the summer me and my friends will be cranking out on Ball Game ideas which I will send to my girlfriend for her to eventually be annoyed by it so stay tuned :)


Thank you for listening to my rant and be ready to ball game.

~ Thomas
